test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

"The house was painted by them last month."

options.text: They paint the house last month.
They have painted the house last month.
They were painting the house last month.
They painted the house last month.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The house was painted by them last month."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "They" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was painted" to "painted" (past simple active).
 
• Ensure the time phrase "last month" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They painted the house last month."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"They paint the house last month." – Incorrect tense (present simple instead of past simple).
 
• **Option 2: **"They have painted the house last month." – Incorrect tense (present perfect instead of past simple).
 
• **Option 3: **"They were painting the house last month." – Incorrect aspect (past continuous instead of past simple).
